# Debra's Classic Cleaning LLC

> Trusted residential house cleaning, maid service, office cleaning, and commercial janitorial services based in Rocklin, CA (2718 Wyatt Ct, Rocklin, CA 95765). Serving Rocklin, Roseville, Granite Bay, Lincoln, Loomis, Folsom, Auburn, Sacramento, Citrus Heights, Orangevale, Fair Oaks, Rancho Cordova, Carmichael, Davis, West Sacramento, and Beale AFB / Yuba County since 2016.

## Residential House Cleaning & Maid Services
- [House Cleaning & Maid Service Hub](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/)
- [Standard House Cleaning](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/standard-cleaning/): Typical 3-bed/2-bath home costs $155–$230/visit. Kid-, pet-, stone-, and hardwood-safe products.
- [Deep House Cleaning](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/deep-cleaning/): Hand-wiped baseboards, cabinet fronts, door frames, blinds, and heavy kitchen/bathroom detailing ($275–$450 typical).
- [Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/move-out-cleaning/): Empty-home turnover cleaning inside cabinets, drawers, closets, and appliances ($320–$540 typical).
- [Recurring House Cleaning (Weekly / Biweekly / Monthly)](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/recurring-cleaning/): Save 20% weekly, 15% biweekly, or 10% monthly with a consistent background-checked team and zero long-term contracts.
- [Vacation Rental & Airbnb Turnover Cleaning](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/vacation-rental-cleaning/): Same-day 11 AM–3 PM guest turnovers, linen resets, and photo staging reports.
